The file isn't in the standard locations. Let me check common upload directories and look for recently modified data files.

```python
import os, time

# Check likely upload dirs and environment variables
for p in ['/mnt', '/home', '/workspace', '/data', '/uploads', '/tmp', '/var/tmp', '/root', '/content']:
    if os.path.exists(p):
        print(p, '->', os.listdir(p)[:20])

print('\nENV keys:', [k for k in os.environ if any(s in k.upper() for s in ('UPLOAD','DATA','FILE','SESSION','FILE','WORK'))])
```
